title: JMedEthicBench: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Evaluating Medical Safety in Japanese Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, JMedEthicBench, measures the medical safety of Large Language Models in Japanese healthcare, based on 67 guidelines from the Japan Medical Association. It evaluates the models' ability to refuse harmful or unethical medical questions in multi-turn conversations.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
